title: Close MM-06 Forge human visual and touch review
steps: Review the MM-06 spec, plan and task evidence against the current Godot Forge implementation.
Run all automated Forge, navigation, parser/import, scene-smoke and Web/PWA checks.
Exercise the Forge flow on supported desktop/mobile targets when available and capture dated evidence.
Verify private Sandbox previews cannot enter competitive collection/deck state without MM-07/MM-08 gates.
Record visual/touch defects as a later backlog unless they are release-critical; do not block unrelated PR review.
acceptance: MM-06 has explicit human visual/touch evidence or an honest pending owner/action, with Sandbox trust-boundary behavior preserved.
